Use the [simulation chooser](examples.qmd) to find the PDK notebook for a calculation.
Backend course pages retain their paths and anchors as detailed references.
To check from a layout repository that a layout can be modeled, use the
[layout modeling check](layout-modeling-check.qmd).

## Page placement {#page-migration}

| Current pages | Treatment in the site |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md`, `index.qmd`, `docs/course/installation.qmd` | Retain as package overview and setup entry points. |
| `docs/examples.qmd` | The simulation-goal chooser. |
| `docs/course/*.qmd` | Retain backend and task detail at existing URLs; link to the PDK notebooks through the simulation chooser. |
| `docs/tutorial-xmon-input.qmd`, `docs/tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd`, `docs/tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd` | Flip-chip Xmon examples in Tutorial. |
| `docs/concepts/*.qmd`, `docs/eigenmode-epr.qmd` | Retain in Concept. |
| `docs/backend-support.qmd`, `docs/specs/*.qmd`, `docs/execution-profiles.qmd`, `docs/mesh-quality.qmd`, `docs/layout-modeling-check.qmd`, `docs/supported-scope.qmd`, `docs/supported-geometry.qmd`, `docs/known-geometry-problems.qmd`, `docs/report-model.qmd`, `docs/api-migration.qmd`, `docs/notebook-ux.qmd`, `docs/geometry-sgb.qmd`, `docs/geometry-preview.qmd`, `docs/amr-analysis.qmd`, `docs/conventions.qmd`, `docs/knowledge-guide.qmd`, `docs/api/*.qmd` | Retain in Contract as the source for supported behavior and detailed interfaces. |
| `docs/contributing.qmd`, `docs/documentation-map.qmd`, `docs/architecture.qmd`, `docs/goals-and-upstream.qmd`, `docs/provenance.qmd`, `docs/ownership.qmd` | Keep their URLs and group them under Contribution as project references. |
| `docs/research/index.qmd`, `docs/research/geometry-build/*.qmd` | Retain in Research as measurement studies. |
| `docs/history/aedt-capacitance-pre-v3.qmd` | Keep in the Historical reference group of Tutorial. |
| `docs/history/curved-source-installation.qmd` | Keep in Research as the pinned historical environment and native Palace setup for the Circular Pad study. |
| `zh-TW/docs/design/sgb/*.qmd` | The SGB design pages, in Traditional Chinese only, with their own sidebar. |

## PDK notebooks by simulation goal {#pdk-notebooks-by-goal}

The OrcaPen SC PDK owns the complete notebook for each goal, with its component,
settings and SCGSim environment. The links below are the notebook sources at
PDK revision `49e539f`, the revision the [home page](../index.qmd#install)
installs.

| What you get | PDK notebook |
| --- | --- |
| SimplePad conductor capacitance matrix | [Palace Electrostatic](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.qmd) · [AEDT Q3D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.qmd) |
| SimplePad mode frequencies | [Palace Eigenmode and EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.qmd) · [HFSS Eigenmode and surface EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd) |
| SimplePad surface, bulk and branch energy participation per mode | The same two notebooks: [Palace](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.qmd) · [HFSS](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd) |
| Finite-ground CPW per-unit-length C, G, L and R matrices | [AEDT Q2D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.qmd) |

The PDK has no current notebook for the finite-ground CPW two-port
S-parameters; its HFSS Driven Terminal notebooks use the
[17-bridge CPW–meander coupon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge).

## OrcaPen to SCGSim topics

OrcaPen supplies the component and process-specific case. Link its page to the
SCGSim topic that owns the reusable model, solver, mesh, handoff, or result
detail. Resolve cross-site links to the SCGSim revision named by the selected
OrcaPen tutorial.

| OrcaPen source page | SCGSim topic entry |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/notebooks.qmd` | [Simulation overview](examples.qmd) and [topic index](reference.qmd). |
| `docs/simulation/requirements/electrostatic-capacitance.qmd` | [Model and materials](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [conductors and ports](reference.qmd#conductors-ports). |
| `docs/simulation/requirements/eigenmode.qmd`, `docs/simulation/requirements/epr-loss.qmd` | [Model and materials](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [saved fields and offline loss](reference.qmd#saved-fields-offline-loss). |
| `docs/simulation/tools/mesh-fem-amr.qmd` | [Mesh and adaptation](reference.qmd#mesh-adaptation). |
| `docs/simulation/tools/handoff-resolve-report.qmd` | [Execution and handoff](reference.qmd#execution-handoff) and [results and reports](reference.qmd#results-reports). |

The OrcaPen links above identify component-source revisions. For reusable
SCGSim interfaces, use the
matching topic entry in the [SCGSim reference](reference.qmd).
